passages.interpretation: Database identities, version conflict counter, integrity_hold, and referee_private_note return no values and permit no model analysis. integrity_hold remains private Action verification-only data, as allowed by the source.

passages.interpretation: The Action privately verifies an open related event, finished result, exactly two winner wins, loser wins of zero or one, and no integrity hold. Its require gate refuses invalid requests before approval.

passages.interpretation: The compiled update modifies result_state and Runner-owned version advancement only. It cannot change score, winner, referee assignment, event, tenant, or other business fields; the compiled version increment covers the maintained conflict counter.
passages.next_step: Retain the restricted effect envelope and compiled version advancement.

passages.interpretation: Both automatic limits select all approved outcomes because their history_selector capability is null. The source limits automatic qualifying-stage ratifications; without the required outcome capability filter, human-approved or other approved outcomes can consume these automatic allowances. The maximums, scopes, inclusive 24-hour windows, and applies-to-outcome behavior otherwise match.
passages.next_step: Revise the two history selectors so they count only automatic league.result_ratification approvals.

passages.interpretation: Apart from the counted-outcome selector conflict, the compiled limits are count limits with maximum two at tenant scope and six at boundary scope, each using an inclusive 86,400-second rolling window. Operator message 3 establishes that the trusted tenant is one league, so the tenant-scoped limit is shared across its referees; no per-referee cap remains.
passages.next_step: Retain the two shared limits while repairing only their counted-outcome selectors.

passages.interpretation: Automatic approval is limited to valid qualifying-stage requests. passages.next_step: Retain qualifying-only auto-approval and league-supervisor human fallback.
